headline: Grupo EMS Launches Semaglutide Pen in Brazilian Weight-Loss Market
summary: Grupo EMS launched a domestically manufactured semaglutide weight-loss pen under its Brace Pharma unit, entering pharmacies at R$ 464.81 per unit.
why: Market entry into high-demand pharmaceutical sectors like weight-loss treatments can significantly alter competitive dynamics and revenue streams for domestic drugmakers.

impacts.name: Pharmaceutical Sector
impacts.why: New product launches increase competition in the Brazilian weight-loss pharmaceutical market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
